title: Broad Haven school sighting
place: Broad Haven C.P. School, Broad Haven, Pembrokeshire
desc: Around 14 boys and one girl aged 9-11 reported a silvery, domed cigar- or saucer-shaped craft in a boggy field roughly 300-400 yards from the school at lunchtime, some describing a silver-suited figure with pointed ears beside it. Existing entry - extra sources added (OSM places the school building at 51.7783,-5.0999).

place: Haven Fort Hotel, Little Haven, Pembrokeshire
desc: In the early hours Rose (Rosa) Granville, who ran the Haven Fort Hotel, heard a buzzing and saw a brightly lit oval or 'upside-down saucer' in the neighbouring field, with two tall humanoid figures in whitish or silver suits with long arms and blank faces apparently searching or measuring the ground.
